gaps.where: Set up your business → "A simple page for your business" (Your page is at … with Copy the link / Open it) and "Your booking page is ready" (Customers book at … with Copy the link / Open it); phone: Share the link
gaps.gap: The setup screens show and copy the full link `${usePublicOrigin(brandedOrigin)}/book/<slug>`. No Assistant read returns one: read_onboarding_setup_get gives only state.page.slug and state.booking.site.slug; get_settings booking_site (booking_site.get) gives only `path: /book/<slug>`; and update_booking_site's outcome says "Your booking page is at /book/<slug>". Neither the prompt nor the context names the default origin. The worker knows it (env.webUrl), and tools-forms.ts already builds full links from it, but only for the form it sends.
gaps.fix: Fixed: read_onboarding_setup_get gives state.page.link and state.booking.site.link as /book/<slug>, and the executor writes them out whole on the business’s own address (its branded domain, else the app’s), as it does every public link; nothing is guessed.

gaps.where: Every link the setup screens show (booking page, simple page, chat) and the Assistant's own words about the default address
gaps.gap: The prompt's only link example is https://handsfreeos.com/book/acme. The settings map and tool description both say links are served "instead of handsfreeos.com". The branded-domain cards and outcomes tell the person their links are "on handsfreeos.com". Public links actually live on https://app.handsfreeos.com, and the marketing site at handsfreeos.com has no /book or /f route or redirect, so a guessed handsfreeos.com/book/<slug> link is a dead link.
gaps.fix: Fixed: the prompt’s example now says to give only a link a tool or these instructions gave whole, never one put together from a slug or a path.

gaps.where: Every setup screen's Next (each screen saves the whole answers object, changing only that screen's fields)
gaps.gap: do_onboarding_setup_save takes the whole `answers` object, and every field has a default. The handler stores `draft: answers` as sent (except on 'business', where it is still built from input.answers) and acts on it: 'paid' saves or removes the review link, 'customers' rewrites goal, customersIn and teamSize and sets as-you-go, and 'page' with the default usePage=true puts the page live. The worker's executor passes the model's arguments straight through, with no merge over the stored answers. The model sees only the command description and schema, and nothing tells it to resend every answer it read. The Confirm card shows `Answers` clipped to 300 characters, so the reset is not visible either.
gaps.fix: Fixed: do_onboarding_setup_save and _finish, and do_ai_setup_save and _finish, read the setup as the person first and lay the model’s answers over the ones kept (the AI teammate’s one by one), so a save changes only what was given (apps/worker/src/assistant/setup-screens.ts mergedAnswers). The descriptions say to pass only the answers the screen changes.

gaps.where: "Stay in the loop" → "What will change" list, then Save changes (a business that already has a teammate); "Your booking page is ready" list of what was made
gaps.gap: For a business that already has a teammate, Stay in the loop lists planOnboardingSetup(state, answers).changes before Save changes. The Assistant's card for do_onboarding_setup_finish (and do_onboarding_setup_save, do_ai_setup_finish) shows only `What: <description clipped to 300>`, then the input keys with JSON clipped to 300. The rehearsal's output is thrown away, and the model gets only {waiting:true, what}. So neither the person nor the model sees the changes, or the hand-over role (owner or admin).
gaps.fix: Fixed: the card is drawn from the rehearsed save: the screen, the answers it changes, “What this changes in the business” from the save’s changes (or that nothing else changes yet), what it couldn’t do as notes, and for an agency’s finish who it’s handed to and what they join as (the owner, or an admin), with Hand it over (setupCard).

gaps.where: "Your business number": the list of free numbers near the address, toll-free numbers, Area code + Search, Show numbers anywhere, then Get <number>
gaps.gap: Number search (near the address, by area code, local or toll-free, or anywhere) is a worker HTTP route, not a command or query. So no screen-read, screen action or tool covers it. manage_phone_number can only buy a number the person types out, and says so. Nothing on a NEVER list excludes the search. Lowered to medium: the Assistant routes correctly to the screen and says nothing wrong; it just can't do the look-up.
gaps.fix: Fixed: new look-up find_phone_numbers (channels.manage, runs on its own): near the business’s address (25 miles, or as far as asked) with nothing asked, or by area code or toll-free prefix, digits, another city and state with a distance, anywhere, or toll-free; a state with no city is refused rather than searched somewhere else; it buys nothing and says to get the one the person picks with manage_phone_number, whose description now says so.

gaps.where: Set up your business: where it opens (Carry on where you left off), the answers on every screen, the hand-over state
gaps.gap: runScreenRead cuts any answer over 16,000 characters of JSON and returns a string. onboarding_setup.get puts `state` first, and it holds the fully parsed teammate config (16 modules with every default), the profile, the facts with their bodies, and `found`. Then come `answers` and a full duplicate in `starting`; reached, started, handedOver, handOverAs, finished and templates come last. The query takes only workspaceId, so "ask for less" can't be followed. This is conditional: it bites mainly once a teammate exists, which includes the owner checking an agency's hand-over, where handedOver and handOverAs are what matter. Lowered to medium.
gaps.fix: Fixed: read_onboarding_setup_get has a worker shape (setupRead): where it is first (reached, where it opens, progress, the screens), then the hand-over, the answers and a trimmed state (the teammate as id, name, status and revision; facts as titles; found as its address and counts), with Start over’s picks last. read_ai_setup_get is trimmed the same way.

gaps.where: Set up your business (/onboarding/<business>): its screens and buttons (Next, Back, Finish later, Carry on where you left off + Start over, Save and hand it over, Check what <agency> set up with Change something / Finish my part, Go to Home), and the setup wizard (/onboarding/<business>/setup/<step>: steps down the side, Skip for now, Continue, Finish later)
gaps.gap: No APP_PLACES entry, settings area or prompt line names the guided setup (/onboarding/<business>), its screens (Your business, Your goal … Stay in the loop / Hand it over), its buttons, or the setup wizard. Home's Getting started line leaves out the banner that opens it: Set up your business → Start, Finish setting up your business → Carry on, or <agency> set up your business → Check it and finish. The prompt forbids naming unlisted places, so the Assistant can't direct anyone back into the setup. Lowered to medium because Home's Getting started is described.
gaps.fix: Fixed: the places map has Set up your business (/onboarding/<business>: its stops, buttons, the agency’s hand-over and the owner’s check) and A setup step (/onboarding/<business>/setup/<step>: The basics, Finish later, Back, Skip for now, Continue), and Home names the setup banner and Take the tour.

gaps.where: "Stay in the loop" Save for a business with no website: the AI teammate's chat goes on the simple page's address
gaps.gap: do_onboarding_setup_finish (and do_ai_setup_finish) takes `pageOrigin` from the model. Its explanation is a JSDoc comment, not .describe(), so the model sees only an optional string. No tool gives the origin. If it is left out, a business with only the simple page gets no chat, and the note saying so is dropped (onb-8). If it is guessed as https://handsfreeos.com (onb-5), the widget is created with the wrong allowedOrigins.
gaps.fix: Fixed: do_onboarding_setup_finish and do_ai_setup_finish put pageOrigin on in the worker from the business’s own address, so the website chat can go on the simple page; the model can’t give it.

gaps.where: After a setup screen saves: notes in a toast ("Sam is already in this business."), the booking screen's list of what it made and its warnings (calendar couldn't be turned on), the hand-over banner ("<email> has an email…"), and "Your page’s chat wasn’t added this time…"
gaps.gap: commitScreenAction ignores executeCommand's output and returns outcome 'Done'. routes.ts stores only {outcome, href, command}. The notes (already a member, invitation pending, the calendar couldn't be turned on, the page's chat wasn't added), `changes`, `invited` and `handedOver` are lost. A later read_onboarding_setup_get shows some results (booking.on, chat, team.invited) but not why.
gaps.fix: Fixed: once saved, the card says what changed and what the save couldn’t do and how to (setupOutcome), in place of Done.

gaps.where: "Your setup so far" summary beside every screen ("See the summary" on the phone), the counter "3 of 15 · About your business", the done screen "It’s already working for you", and the owner's check screen with "Your part"
gaps.gap: onboarding_setup.get returns only the raw state and answers. Core already works out the summary sentences, the opening screen, the ordered screens with skips, "3 of 15" progress, titles and the owner's part, but these are only rendered on the screens. The Assistant would have to re-derive the skip rules to say what's left.
gaps.fix: Fixed: the setup read gives opensAt and its title and hint, progress (“3 of 15 · About your business”), the screens left with their titles and stops, the summary (Your setup so far, and the checking and done lines), and yourPart while the owner checks an agency’s setup, all from core’s own helpers.

gaps.where: Phone: Home's Getting started → Set up your business / Carry on (the whole guided setup on the phone, with Email me a link for parts easier on a computer)
gaps.gap: The prompt says "the business is set up on the web". PHONE_APP lists "the business's settings" as only on the web, and has no line for the guided setup. Yet the phone runs the same Set up your business at /app/w/<id>/setup, opened from Home's Getting started, and core's own words say "here or in the phone app".
gaps.fix: Fixed: the prompt says Set up your business runs on the phone too, and PHONE_APP says it starts or carries on from Home’s Getting started, with Email me a link for steps easier on a computer.

gaps.where: "Get the phone app" dialog: App Store and Google Play links with QR codes (customers stop "My phone’s contacts", Stay in the loop, Getting started's app and notifications steps)
gaps.gap: PHONE_APP_LINKS holds the App Store and Google Play URLs the Get the phone app dialog shows. No Assistant tool, prompt line, places-map line or settings handover carries them, and get_settings my_account has none either.
gaps.fix: Fixed: PHONE_APP gives both store links, built from PHONE_APP_LINKS, and says they may be given as they are.

gaps.where: "Where are your customers now?" → GoHighLevel ("Paste a private integration token from GoHighLevel. The move runs while you carry on.")
gaps.gap: settings_help(migrations) tells the person to "pick the system and sign in there", but no source offers sign-in now (SIGN_IN_SOURCES is []). GoHighLevel takes a pasted private integration token plus the sub-account's Location ID. migrations.canChange is [], and get_settings and settings_help return it as such, even though migration.create/scan/select/map_scopes/start/pause/resume/retry/resolve_merge are screen actions. The prompt also lists "moving in from another system" as wholly the person's. The token itself rightly stays with the person.
gaps.fix: Fixed: the migrations help says the person connects the system they’re moving from (signing in, or pasting a private token and the Location ID at GoHighLevel), which only they can do; its words follow the screen, and the prompt says the same.

gaps.where: Settings → Workspace cards the setup points to: "Logo and colour", "Your page" ("Turn your page on any time in Settings → Workspace"), "Getting started guide"
gaps.gap: Partly covered: Home's howTo already names "Settings → Workspace, Getting started guide", and the website_chat area says the logo is "as on Settings → Workspace". The real gap: the business area's onScreen and canChange list only the Workspace form, Your own web address and Delete. They don't list the Logo and colour card or the Your page card (link, Copy the link, on/off), which the setup's own words send people to. SETTING_TOOLS already maps them (do_look_set, do_booking_site_set_page, do_onboarding_set_enabled).
gaps.fix: Fixed: the business area of the settings map lists the street address, logo and colour, Your page on or off, and Getting started on or off, where each is changed.

gaps.where: Home → Getting started: each step's title, its line ("Skipped for now…", "Waiting on the carriers…"), its button and where it goes
gaps.gap: read_onboarding_status returns each step as key, group, mustDo, state, since and raw note only. The step titles (stepTitle in core onboarding/words.ts, e.g. 'Email & website chat', 'Sign in faster'), the line and button, and where each goes (stepPath in core onboarding/paths.ts, which depends on note.phase) are all in core but not returned. No other Assistant tool covers Getting started.
gaps.fix: Fixed: read_onboarding_status gives each step’s title, line, badge and button as Home’s card shows them, and where the button goes (a settings place, its own setup step, or the phone app); next comes with its title (gettingStartedRead).

gaps.where: Home → Getting started: "Sign in faster" shows done for someone who signs in with Google or a passkey; the count "N of M done" and "You’re set up" follow it
gaps.gap: 'Sign in faster' is done only when device.signIn===true. The web asks again with signIn from the browser, but the worker never fills `device`. The model could pass device.signIn itself (it's in the screen-read input), but no read tells it the person's sign-in methods; get_settings my_account's meShape has only name, email, settings and alerts. So read_onboarding_status counts differ from the card, and do_onboarding_finish is refused with onboarding_not_finished.
gaps.fix: Left open: not a small step. The worker’s AuthAdmin (apps/worker/src/account/auth-admin.ts) could read a person’s Google sign-in with getUserById and their passkeys with Supabase’s admin passkey API, but read_onboarding_status and do_onboarding_finish (both take device) run through the screen-read and screen-action executors, which aren’t given the worker’s services; wiring them in, with a test against Supabase Auth, is a step of its own. Until then the person’s word can be passed as device.signIn.

gaps.where: Next on each screen is refused until the screen is right: Your business needs a name and what you do, a started address must be whole, About with "Do customers book a time?" Yes needs a service, and the AI screens' own checks
gaps.gap: The real part: onboarding_setup.save never runs onboardingSetupScreenProblems. So on 'about' (books a time but no service) and the AI screens (facts, meet, voice, qualify, chat and so on), the Assistant can save and move `reached` past answers the screen would refuse, and finish refuses later with that earlier screen's message. The 'business' part is mostly not real: the save input validates an address with the full BusinessAddress schema, and name and industry are optional (left out means unchanged), so a half address can't be saved. Lowered to low, because finish does refuse with a clear path and message.
gaps.fix: Fixed: onboarding_setup.save runs the screen’s own checks (onboardingSetupScreenProblems) before saving any screen past the first, so a save the screen would refuse is refused with the same words and paths, and the setup stays where it was.

gaps.where: Confirm card warning for do_onboarding_setup_save
gaps.gap: The card warning names "the team screen", but there is no such screen. Invitations go from 'goal' (stop 'Your goal', under How many people work with you?). The warning also leaves out the first screen's business changes and website read, 'customers' setting add-them-as-you-go and Home's order, and 'paid' saving or removing the review link. The command description mentions these, but the card clips it at 300 characters.
gaps.fix: Fixed: the save’s warning names every screen that acts as it’s saved and what it does: Your business (name, kind, address, time zone, website, and reading it), Your goal’s invitations, Your page, Your customers, Your booking page, and Payments and reviews’ review link; the card also lists what that save would change.

gaps.where: Get help menu while Getting started isn't finished: Getting started, Take the tour, Ask us for help; and "New here? … Take the tour" on the card
gaps.gap: The Get help → Getting started item is already known (places-map.ts:47). The real gap is that Take the tour, in the Get help menu and on the Getting started card, appears in no Assistant source, so "show me the tour again" can't be answered. EVERY_PAGE also still describes Get help only as the message form.
gaps.fix: Fixed: EVERY_PAGE’s Get help says that while Getting started isn’t finished it is a menu first (Getting started, Take the tour, Ask us for help), and Home says how to take the tour again.

gaps.where: "Your business" → Your address (optional): Street address, Suite or unit, City, State, ZIP code (sets the time zone shown to confirm)
gaps.gap: The address on estimates and invoices is already covered: Settings → Payments → Your address, through update_money_settings.businessAddress, which settings-map lists. The real gap is the setup's structured address (workspace settings.address). The setup screen shows it and it sets the time zone; documents fall back to it, and the number search, the texting registration and postal campaigns use it. The Assistant can change it only through do_onboarding_setup_save with screen 'business' and business.address, which carries onb-2's answers risk, and no map or update_business line routes "change our business address" there. A person asking will likely get only the invoice header changed.
gaps.fix: Fixed: update_business takes the street address (BusinessAddress), shows it on its card, and says when the address is on another time zone than the business keeps, without changing the zone unless asked; a bad address is refused with what’s wrong.
